items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: George set in to play for me, you know.

ctx.x: -- (unintelligible) Then lots of times especially when you play down in the kitchen. You had a lot of set-ins, a guy would come by, you know, he was a bass player, and I say to George Joyce, come on George Joyce, come on up here, so -- George set in to play for me, you know. Get tired and go. (unintelligible).
